replies.pt: O hacker da Binance moveu outros 78.415 ETH (US$ 142 mi) para lavar, trocando por BTC via THORChain (127 lk / 32 rep). Numeros da fonte.
replies.a: bro is the only one in this market consistently shipping volume this year
replies.b: $142M routed in one shot. that is an execution problem before it is anything else — atomic rfq exists for exactly this
replies.c: laundering through a router is the most honest onboarding story crypto has

replies.pt: MNT entrou na GMO Coin, exchange regulada no Japao (97 lk / 19 rep) — praca regulada japonesa para o token.
replies.a: regulated listing in japan and my group chat still cannot stay regulated for 5 minutes
replies.b: a listing is the easy part. can you actually get size in and out of it? depth and spreads or it is just a screenshot
replies.c: japan is always early on the weird stuff. respect

style_rules.anti_dup_texto: nenhuma letra repete texto de outra reply da mesma edicao; o angulo (b) varia (venue, 24h, RFQ, uptime, size) e nao repete 'a bolsa fecha' duas vezes

modal_card_v2.regra: Entrega em UM show_block: link clicavel por item, a/b/c em lista uma por linha, opcao nenhuma, campo de porque e um unico send no fim.
